mechanism: Both drugs are CYP3A4 substrates; tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, and sirolimus inhibits CYP3A4, potentially increasing tolterodine concentrations.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic side effects (urinary retention, constipation, cognitive effects); consider dose reduction of tolterodine or use alternative antimuscarinic if excessive anticholinergic effects occur.
